page.layout: Running head across the top: left page header "א ג" with page number "24" at the far left; right page header "א ם". Two columns of dictionary entries, left column then right column. Below the right column, after a blank line, a centred section letter "א ם" and further entries continue in the right column. No marginal notes, no footnotes.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants are copied as far as legible; the vowel points in several Hebrew words (especially the first words of entries, e.g. אֲנִיעָר, אֲסוֹבְּה, אָסוּר) are uncertain at this scan resolution and may differ from the printed points. The section letter "א ם" below the right column is a bare letter, so it is written as a paragraph. Latin "ulciscar" is printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s.
